# 💳 GWS Gmail

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the Google Workspace CLI skill for Gmail: `gws gmail` covers the full Gmail API surface — send, read, reply, reply-all, forward, drafts, labels, threads, history, settings, plus helper commands like `+send`, `+triage` (unread inbox summary), and `+watch` (stream new mail as NDJSON). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires a Google Workspace account (paid subscription — no free tier) with the `gws` CLI installed and authenticated; email actions are real — sending and deleting actually happen. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
